labelImport.intro: Read Korean and English text in a photo to fill in bean details. JPG, PNG, WebP · up to 10 MB

labelImport.cancelled: Reading cancelled. Your entered details are unchanged.
labelImport.rawTextHint: This is the text as recognized. Compare it with the photo and enter any details yourself below.
